instruction: Rework the evidence and implementation so the evaluated SHA has either a passing mandatory contract check or an approved skip, then replace the hard-coded golden-cost claim with measurements from an executed direct episode covering lifecycle calls, tool calls, duplicate context, verified success, lifecycle ownership, and committed-scope enforcement.

findings.summary: The mandatory contract check fails on the evaluated SHA, and the recorded verification state remains needs_rework.

The claimed 0.6.24 cost improvement is calculated from hard-coded candidate values rather than measurements from an executed direct golden-path episode; the implementation also derives baseline tool calls from an expected lifecycle trace and explicitly states that provider-internal tool calls were not recorded.
